title: Guerrero & Malenko make technique an ECW attraction
summary: Eddie Guerrero and Dean Malenko offer a championship rivalry built on counters and precision. Their series demonstrates that ECW’s audience embraces technical wrestling alongside its violent spectacle.

chapters.title: A Television title stalemate
chapters.result: Champion Guerrero and Malenko wrestle to a time-limit draw.
chapters.context: Neither can establish a decisive advantage in the developing rivalry.

chapters.title: A farewell without a winner
chapters.result: Their two-out-of-three-falls match ends in a draw.
chapters.context: The crowd celebrates both wrestlers before their departures for WCW.
